opportunities.name: Research paper to legal case note chain
opportunities.description: For a topic, find a paper on arXiv (advanced search with year), look up its citations on Semantic Scholar and save a note; then do the same for a legal case via CourtListener and Cornell LII statute, saving a note.
steps: Open arXiv advanced search, enter topic, tick subject, set specific year, search
Open the first result and note its title
Search the title on Semantic Scholar and open the result
Add a note to Notes: topic (year): title by first author, citations
Search case name on CourtListener and open the case
Search the cited statute on Cornell LII and open it
Add a note: case: citation, decided date, see statute (title)

opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a title term with a subject checkbox and specific year, then open the top result.
steps: Click Search then Advanced search
Type search term
Tick subject checkbox
Select Specific year and type year
Click Search
Open first result
